title: G5: Don't automatically un-pair on phones that can't automatically re-pair
symptom: On phones that require user intervention to pair with a Bluetooth device, the G5 collectors automatically un-pair from the G5 to resolve connection problems, which makes things worse because xDrip won't get data until the user manually intervenes.
cause: The G5 collectors automatically un-pair from the G5 to try to resolve a connection problem, but on phones that can't re-pair automatically, this prevents data collection until manual intervention.
fix: xDrip should not automatically un-pair on phones that can't automatically re-pair. The issue was resolved in the nightly, and the user confirmed it works as expected with fewer instances of manual repair.
evidence_quote: Yup, it's working as expected -- far fewer instances where I have to manually repair because OB1 unpaired automatically.
